summary: Server one-frame request to create a spell zone (cone/line area of a spell; seen alive when a Mud Mephit cast a spell, born together with esv::zone::SpellComponent and FinishedEventOneFrameComponent). It is one esv::zone::CreationParams (0x188 bytes): esv::zone::CreationSystem::ProcessCreateRequests (EoCServer.dll+0x114C5E0) walks CreationParams with stride 0x188, creates the zone entity, fills esv::zone::SpellComponent from it and copies the whole CreationParams with the assignment EoCServer.dll+0x114C290, which gives every member's offset and width. The builder EoCServer.dll+0x164DC50 names the member types (SpellId, InitialTarget, eoc::SpellZoneInfo, optional arrays of AiTilePos / EntityHandle / HitDesc). Game defaults from creator bg3.exe+0x3377AF0.

fields.name: StoryActionId
fields.evidence: macOS esv::functor::StatsFunctorCreateZone::Execute (bg3_macos_x64+0x64CB660), whose demangled signature is (StoryActionID, EntityHandle, Guid, HitDesc, AttackDesc, Vector3f, Vector3f, EntityHandle, SpellId, EAbility, InitialTarget, ESurfaceType, SpellZoneInfo&&, uint, float, float, AiTilePos[]*, EntityHandle[]*, HitDesc[]*, bool, bool, FixedString, int, bool), fills a local esv::zone::CreationParams (0x188 bytes, copy-constructed into the request array). It stores the first argument, ls::TypeWrap<unsigned int, eoc::TStoryActionIDClassname>, at CreationParams +0 (the first slot of the local copy). The Windows builder EoCServer.dll+0x164DC50 likewise stores its second parameter here, and its parameter order matches the macOS signature at every other field: Guid +0x10 = its 4th parameter, Vector3f +0x28/+0x34 = its 7th/8th, EntityHandle +0x20 = its 9th. Game default -1. Live 0x2E / 0x126.

fields.name: SpellCast
fields.evidence: macOS esv::functor::StatsFunctorCreateZone::Execute (bg3_macos_x64+0x64CB660) takes this EntityHandle as its second argument. Its spell-cast caller bg3_macos_x64+0x641B5D0 passes the entity at +8 of its 5th parameter, the entity it reads eoc::spell_cast::StateComponent and esv::spell_cast::StateComponent from (and whose state's SpellCastGuid it passes as the Guid stored at +0x10): the spell cast entity. esv::functor::ExecuteStatsFunctors (bg3_macos_x64+0x64E1ED0) passes Unassigned, so a zone made by a functor has none. ProcessCreateRequests copies it to esv::zone::SpellComponent +0 only when valid.
